turns.question: By what percentage did revenue in the week starting Monday 14 September 2026 grow over the week before?
turns.answer: Revenue in the week of 14-20 September 2026 grew 32.65 % (revenue week-over-week growth 0.3265) over the week of 7-13 September, from 2,340.50 EUR to 3,104.75 EUR. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
